explanation: Near 0 at every GO step (at most 1-2). At D1 it is 9-10 if the previous trial chose a1 but landed in S2 (rare), 0-1 if it chose a2 but landed in S1 (rare), and 2-5 after other rewarded trials or 5-8 after other unrewarded ones; at D2 it is 8-10 when a1 leads to S2 (rare), 5-9 when a1 leads to S1 or a2 leads to S2 (common), and 3-5 when a2 leads to S1 (rare), with every value about 2 points higher late in the episode (trial 65 onward) than early.
